agenda: model-quality; defect 2 (boundedness) and defect 3 (seed stability), jointly
question: In the 2x2 of {zero_preserving_nonlinear, homogeneous} x {fixed-10k, mixed-resolution} training (all measure-consistent), which factors buy foreign-family boundedness, and does declaring drive degree one add anything over mixed-resolution sampling?

known_cells.zpn_x_fixed: detonates both families (estate mean 1850 / max 6146; fastback mean 1670 / max 38968), 1 seed
known_cells.zpn_x_mixedres: bounded on all 99 cases of BOTH families at 3/3 seeds (means 0.89-1.05, max <= 1.37, seed band 1.18x); no transfer skill (mean-predictor level)

protocol: identical to the defect-1 experiment otherwise: flagship, 500 epochs, lr 3e-3, bf16, augment=false, DropDegenerateCells, measure-consistent convention, 4-GPU single-node DDP, final-epoch checkpoint only; trained on AGA GB300 (fresh runs, no cross-silicon resumption)
instrument: the stage-0 smoke instrument verbatim (shift_suv_surface fixed-gauge, estate AND fastback val, res 10000, fleet-comparable normalized pressure_l2) plus the defect-1 resolution sweep for the in-family guard

deciding_gates.B1_conjunction_bounded: homog_mixed: pressure_l2 finite and mean < 3.0 on both families for 5/5 seeds
deciding_gates.B2_mixedres_necessity: homog_fixed: same criterion for 3/3 seeds; PASS means mixed-resolution is unnecessary under the declared degree, FAIL localizes boundedness to the sampling axis
deciding_gates.B3_guard_infamily: in-family 10k pressure rel-L2 <= 1.20 x the defect-1 zpn control, per seed (homogeneous historically cost ~15%)
deciding_gates.B4_seed_band_report: report min-max across seeds on the smoke means; no hard bar (the Q2-mirage lesson), but the linear_x_mixedres 1.18x band is the comparison point

exploratory: any seed with smoke mean < 0.8 on either family is flagged as a transfer-skill signal (none expected; p ~ 0.15)

predictions.B1: p ~ 0.8 (mixed-resolution boundedness should survive the mode change)
predictions.B2: p ~ 0.4 (homogeneous alone historically spanned 2.07-5157; the new convention may or may not close it)

falsifier: If B1 fails, the stage-0 boundedness does not compose with the declared-degree mode and the two mechanisms interact destructively -- the conjunction is rejected and zpn x mixedres remains the boundedness baseline.
terminology_correction: The stage-0 preregistration and verdict called the fixed-resolution arms 'linear-mode'. That was a mislabel, caught pre-launch here: the flagship config (and the stage-0 HSG training logs, verified 2026-08-04) uses field_mode=zero_preserving_nonlinear -- the implicit-drive-degree read-in whose off-range amplification the declared-degree wave diagnosed. All 'linear' labels in stage-0 artifacts should read 'zero_preserving_nonlinear'. This makes the stage-1 mode axis exactly the degree-declaration question.
